title: Generalized Normal Constraint (GNC): A Complete Geometric Generalization of the NNC Method
summary: This paper presents a unified geometric, mathematical, and computational framework for the generation of the $complete$ admissible Pareto frontier. Several existing methods are structurally unable to capture the complete admissible Pareto frontier. These include widely used methods such as the weighted sum, the Normal Boundary Intersection (NBI) method, and the Normalized Normal Constraint (NNC) method.
